title: You Can’t Add Days To Your Life

scenes.narration: You can't add days to your life, but you can add life to your days.
scenes.image_query: You can't add days to your life, but you can add life to your days.

scenes.narration: So don't save your love for another day.
scenes.image_query: So don't save your love for another day.

scenes.narration: Say the words you keep inside, hold on a little longer than pride.
scenes.image_query: Say the words you keep inside, hold on a little longer than pride.

scenes.narration: Because in the end, it won't be the years you remember.
scenes.image_query: Because in the end, it won't be the years you remember.

scenes.narration: It'll be the moments you actually felt alive.
scenes.image_query: It'll be the moments you actually felt alive.
